statement: Everything below was recorded BEFORE any scored cell ran and BEFORE any gate output was read. The scored array must be executed against exactly these digests; any drift is a defect run, preserved and reported, never edited. This commit contains NO result file. A post-freeze change to any axis, arm, cost term, stream construction or endpoint requires a recorded supersession with cause and a re-run.
status_before_this_study: PROJECTED, NOT OBSERVED (break-even ~6,123 tasks extrapolated from a 16-task per-task inequality; a 380x extrapolation)
evidence_class: E1 / L1, inherited unchanged from FNA-4

imported_harness_sha256.note: IMPORTED, not copied and not modified. These are byte-identical to FNA4_FREEZE_ADDENDUM_V2.harness_files_sha256_v2, i.e. the exact harness that produced FNA-4 scored run 3 and the ~6,123 projection.

N_FULL_sizing_before_any_scored_cell.decision: 131072 contains source (a) with ~7.6x margin and reaches well into source (b). If no crossing appears by 131072 the answer is 'no crossover within the horizon reached', stated with that horizon and never extrapolated further.

axes.mix_grid_rationale: spans below, through and past the claimed critical band (STITCH_NOGOOD_CEGIS balanced 0.1176 to STITCH balanced 0.1696) and past the all-F1 edges (0.1740, 0.2417)

arms.STITCH_NOGOOD_CEGIS: utility-gated + nogoods + CEGIS; holds PARENT_SUFFICIENT; full horizon
arms.NOGOOD_ONLY_per_batch: failed-experience only, no library, full horizon
arms.SHUFFLE_NULL: shuffle-equal-n null of STITCH, full horizon
arms.SHUFFLE_NULL_NC: shuffle-equal-n null of STITCH_NOGOOD_CEGIS, full horizon

reduced_horizon_rule.rule: An arm runs the reduced horizon iff FNA-4's frozen per-family deltas make its saving/task negative at EVERY point of the mix grid under BOTH compositions, so no horizon can cross. Recomputed and asserted in preflight(), never asserted by hand.
reduced_horizon_rule.independent_agreement: unscored timing probe (salt 999001): AU_PAIR 15x, EGGRAPH 12x, CHUNK 1.7x the incumbent's F2 cost
reduced_horizon_rule.pre_registered_escalation: if any reduced arm's measured saving/task CI includes zero at any grid point, that arm is escalated to the full horizon in a NEW frozen study, never by extending this grid

cost_model: UNCHANGED from FNA-4: one commensurable integer unit per backend simulation, checker call, posting read or learner step; macro bodies charge one simulation per internal step; hole-domain enumeration, misfire probes, rejected candidates and CEGIS refinements all charged; INCUMBENT_CAP=1000000 and DOMAIN_CAP=24 uniform across every arm (parent parity). A burden number that drops a term is a defect, not an improvement.

stream_construction.family_allocation: prefix-preserving deficit allocator; realised family shares match targets to within one task at EVERY prefix length; ties break by the frozen order F2, F1, F3
stream_construction.declared_difference_from_fna4: FNA-4 draws a stream from one shared random.Random; this study seeds a fresh random.Random per position from (SALT_RV8, mix_idx, composition, seed, pos). Same gen_task over the same parameter spaces, so the marginal draw distribution is identical, but any worker can regenerate any prefix independently -- which is what makes a 131,072-task ladder parallelisable and prefix-reproducible.
stream_construction.no_forced_parameters: FNA-4's sweep builder fills its uncovered quota from _f1_param_space() in PRODUCT ORDER, so at r=0 its twelve F1 tasks are near-identical draws from one corner of a 648-tuple space. These are natural draws. The difference is measured by the replication gate, not assumed.

hard_gates.selection_mirror: production SolveOperatorIndex counts must equal brute force, else CANNOT_CHECK_SELECTION_MIRROR_DISAGREES_WITH_PRODUCTION_INDEX

endpoints: present cost: acquisition in BOTH FNA-4 accountings (full and marginal)
future reuse: cumulative PAIRED saving vs NO_LIBRARY on the same task at the same position, reported SEPARATELY from present cost and never netted before both are shown

crossover N*: smallest N with cumulative saving >= acquisition, both accountings, with a 95% CI on mean saving/task inverted to a CI on N*; reported as '> N_max, none observed' when no crossing occurs, never extrapolated
critical mix: zero-crossing of saving/task in the mix, with a CI; below it no horizon pays, so N* has a vertical asymptote and the surface carries two different quantities on its two halves
windowed saving/task in 8 disjoint windows, to separate a stationary crossover from a decaying transient (registry saturation, CEGIS domain shrinkage)
capped tasks per arm per cell as a first-class endpoint, plus a pre-registered sensitivity pass recomputing every endpoint excluding them
shuffle-equal-n null at every grid point

registered_predictions.R1: the frozen sweep replication reproduces exactly, and the natural-draw stream at the same mix and length gives a materially SMALLER saving/task than 39,246.8
registered_predictions.R2: STITCH and STITCH_NOGOOD_CEGIS have positive saving/task only above a critical mix, and the measured critical mix has a CI wide enough to make the 11.8-17.0% band a point estimate from 16 draws rather than a boundary
registered_predictions.R3: the measured N* at m=0.50 exceeds the projected 6,123
registered_predictions.R4: CHUNK, AU_PAIR and EGGRAPH have negative saving/task at every grid point; no horizon crosses
registered_predictions.R5: SHUFFLE_NULL has negative saving/task everywhere; the learned library's saving is not reproduced by a shape-matched random one
registered_predictions.R6: capped tasks are rare at low mix and non-negligible at m >= 0.5; excluding them moves saving/task UP for the library arms

legitimate_outcomes: crossover OBSERVED near ~6,123 -> projection confirmed, H1 becomes an observed negative with a measured boundary
crossover observed ELSEWHERE -> the projection was wrong; report by how much and why
NO crossover within the tested horizon -> acquisition never repays in this regime, a stronger negative than the projected one, stated with the horizon actually reached
forbidden: moving the mix, reshaping the stream or extending the grid after seeing results in order to reach a crossing
TRANSFORMER_REPLACED, LLM_EQUIVALENT, NEURAL_SUPERIOR, NEURAL_NECESSARY, GENERAL_SUPERIORITY, AGI

declared_limitations: planted worlds, one author: E1/L1, not E3
inherited from FNA-4: small catalogue, shallow families relative to program-synthesis benchmarks; claim scope is a mechanism class on this substrate, not a benchmark result

INCUMBENT_CAP truncates the deep cost tail and is kept for parent parity; the truncation biases the baseline DOWN and understates the library's saving, which is why capped tasks are a first-class endpoint with a sensitivity pass
the mix axis has three families, so 'same-family share' is F2 share and nothing broader
human prior enters only through the frozen family generators, identically for every arm including NO_LIBRARY
